questions.question: Republic Day of India is celebrated on which date?
questions.funFact: 26 January marks the day in 1950 when the Constitution of India came into effect.

questions.question: Independence Day of India is celebrated on ___.
questions.funFact: India became free from British rule on 15 August 1947.

questions.question: Gandhi Jayanti, the birthday of Mahatma Gandhi, falls on ___.
questions.funFact: Gandhi Jayanti is also observed around the world as the International Day of Non-Violence.

questions.question: Children's Day in India is celebrated on 14 November, the birthday of Jawaharlal Nehru.
questions.funFact: Nehru loved children so much that they fondly called him 'Chacha Nehru'.

questions.question: Teachers' Day in India is celebrated on 5 September, the birthday of Dr. Sarvepalli ___.
questions.funFact: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was a great teacher who later became the second President of India.

questions.question: Match each special day to its date.
questions.funFact: 26 January, 15 August and 2 October are India's three national holidays celebrated all over the country.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a national day of India?
questions.funFact: Halloween is a festival celebrated mostly in Western countries, not a national day of India.

questions.question: International Yoga Day, an idea India gave to the world, is celebrated on ___.
questions.funFact: The very first International Yoga Day was celebrated in 2015, and now people do yoga on this day worldwide.

questions.question: World Environment Day is celebrated on 5 June.
questions.funFact: On World Environment Day, many people plant trees and clean up their neighbourhoods.

questions.question: Every year on 22 April, people around the world celebrate ___ Day to care for our planet.
questions.funFact: Earth Day reminds us to protect nature, save water and keep our planet clean.

questions.question: International Women's Day is celebrated across the world on ___.
questions.funFact: International Women's Day celebrates the achievements of women everywhere.

questions.question: National Science Day in India is celebrated on 28 February.
questions.funFact: This day remembers the discovery of the 'Raman Effect' by the Indian scientist C. V. Raman.
